project: Mario Kart Wii native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Title screen, licence creation and the single-player menu. 54-59 fps in menus (the game drops to 30 fps itself while saving the licence). Known issue: the label inside the yellow confirm bar is missing. Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
